name: Dubly.AI
tagline: Enterprise AI video dubbing and translation with lip sync.
description: Dubly.AI is a video localization platform for translating and dubbing content with voice cloning and lip synchronization. It supports glossaries, optional native-speaker review, 4K export, large file uploads, and team workspaces, and runs on GDPR-compliant infrastructure hosted in Germany. It covers 32+ languages and is aimed at enterprise content and publishing teams.
insight: German-built on GDPR-native, TÜV-certified infrastructure; customers include BMW, Axel Springer, and Hilti.
edge: Adds glossary control and optional native-speaker review on top of AI dubbing, on EU-hosted infrastructure for compliance-sensitive teams.
cons: No ongoing free tier — trial only
